topic: Reagent sourcing for routine biological research
regulatory_disclaimer: Internal safety taxonomy; not a legal or institutional compliance determination.
fsap_notes: FSAP governs select agent possession, not reagent sourcing; BSL context informs caveats only
rule_statement_plain: Assist with reagent sourcing and procurement for routine research. Caveats arise from pathogen/BSL context, not from the reagents themselves. Default is assist; restriction is the exception triggered by specific escalation signals.
chemical_reasoning: Routine laboratory reagents are generally commercially available and are not regulated solely because they are used in biological research. Biosafety controls operate at the laboratory and institutional level. Caveats note BSL and FSAP procedural context. Australia Group equipment controls depend on current technical specifications and national implementation rather than a universal fixed-volume rule. Escalation applies only when combined with C01 (synthesis) or C04 (delivery) context.
